items.headline: Iran and Oman Near Deal on New Strait of Hormuz Shipping Route
items.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi announced that Iran and mediator Oman are close to finalizing an agreement on a new commercial transit route through the Strait of Hormuz [1.4.8]. The potential breakthrough is major news now because it could help stabilize global energy markets and ease months of severe trade disruptions in the strategic waterway.

items.headline: Perseid Meteor Shower Set to Peak with Ideal Dark-Sky Conditions
items.summary: The annual Perseid meteor shower is reaching its peak this week, offering stargazers across the Northern Hemisphere a chance to see up to 100 meteors per hour. Astronomers report that viewing conditions this year are exceptionally favorable because a new moon phase will leave the night sky dark and clear of bright moonlight.

items.headline: Demi Vollering Wins Tour de France Femmes for Second Career Title
items.summary: Dutch cyclist Demi Vollering secured her second overall Tour de France Femmes title on Sunday after winning the final stage in Nice with a solo attack on the Col d'Èze. Her decisive victory on stage nine made her the first two-time overall champion in the history of the modern women's race.
